title: qos_contention T2 captures at 1000ms and 10000ms are byte-identical — the golden set cannot show the queue/serialization visual evolving
evidence: md5 goldens/qos_contention/*.png → 01000ms.png = ebce0e7d9a9d317455b13e2d21f2595c, 10000ms.png = ebce0e7d9a9d317455b13e2d21f2595c (identical); fresh `harness save qos_contention` at ffc9b7b reproduces both byte-for-byte (committed == fresh md5), so the identity is a genuine render property, not a copied file. Pixel analysis: 1000ms vs 10000ms → 0 px differ; 1000ms vs 3000ms → 421 px differ (band y=353..366). Captures at 2000/2500/4000/5500/7000/8500/10000ms are all ebce0e7d (period-1500ms cycle: 1000≡2500≡4000≡5500≡7000≡8500≡10000). draw_packets places queued packets (on_edge, progress 0) at pos = departure node + lane band offset (view.odin: `pos = {depart.x + dx * frac, depart.y + dy * frac}` with frac=0 for progress 0), so all queued packets of a lane draw at the SAME pixel — pile depth is invisible; the demo's own header claims 'captures show the queue + BE-first drops'.
detail: Two of three T2 captures pin the same pixels; queue depth is not visible in the stills (one dot per lane regardless of backlog), so the launchable's serialization visual rests on the T1 + live app, not the named T2 golden.
recommended_fix: Capture at times outside the 1500ms cycle (e.g. 2000/7000ms) or render queued packets with a per-depth offset; document why 10000ms duplicates 1000ms.
